title: The Last Mile to the Real World: Agent-Native Primitives as Reusable Building Blocks for Solving Real-World Tasks
title_zh: 通往真实世界的最后一公里：智能体原生原语作为解决真实世界任务的可复用构建块

paragraphs.en: 提出智能体原生原语与HEELO框架工程方法，通过可复用原语库显著提升智能体解决真实世界任务的能力与效率。 How can an agent handle a real-world task end to end? Frontier models with their own harnesses still fall short on real-world benchmarks: on Terminal-Bench 4.0, GPT-5.6 Sol with Codex resolves 37.3% of the tasks and Claude Opus 5 with Claude Code 51.8%. These tasks fail at the step from reaching a resource to applying it, which we call the last mile to the real world. Existing approaches put the resource within reach but leave the competence to apply it with the caller, so each harness rebuilds that competence. We introduce agent-native primitives, reusable units that equip a resource with a resident LLM that applies it in context and communicates with other primitives, and HEELO (Harness Engineering around Evolving Agent-Native Primitives for the Last Mile to Real-WOrld Tasks), a harness engineering framework that builds each task's harness from a library of such primitives. HEELO composes the primitives a task needs into a task-specific graph, verifies the result against evidence from the environment, revises the primitives a failure implicates, and admits new or improved primitives after validation. We instantiate HEELO with eight primitive families, each built for one kind of task, and evaluate them on more than twenty benchmarks. Dev-Primitives raise Terminal-Bench 4.0 resolution from 37.3% under Codex to 55.5% on the same backbone, Harness Primitives composed per task raise Terminal-Bench 2.0 Pass@1 from 60.0% for the seed harness to 72.2%, Tool Primitives raise ToolBench pass rate from 55.8% to 75.1%, and Navigation Primitives raise GAIA-Text-103 accuracy from 45.6% to 58.3%. On the 46 real-world tasks of our heelo.dev platform, Claude Opus 5.5 with Claude Code and GPT-6.1 Sol with Codex complete 9 each on their own and 39 and 35 when connected to HEELO through our MCP server, with 1.9$\times$ and 2.3$\times$ less time and 1.55$\times$ lower cost per completed task.
paragraphs.zh: 提出智能体原生原语与HEELO框架工程方法，通过可复用原语库显著提升智能体解决真实世界任务的能力与效率。智能体如何端到端地处理一个真实世界任务？ 顶级模型即使配备各自的工具框架，在真实世界基准上仍表现不足：在Terminal-Bench 4.0上，GPT-5.6 Sol搭配Codex解决37.3%的任务，Claude Opus 5搭配Claude Code解决51.8%。 这些任务在从获取资源到应用资源的环节失败，我们将其称为通往真实世界的最后一公里。 现有方法让资源触手可及，却把应用资源的能力留给调用方，因此每个工具框架都得重建这种能力。 我们提出智能体原生原语——为资源配备一个常驻LLM、能在上下文中应用该资源并与其他原语通信的可复用单元——以及HEELO（围绕不断演进的智能体原生原语、面向真实世界任务最后一公里的工具框架工程方法），一个由此类原语库构建每个任务工具框架的工程框架。 HEELO将任务所需的原语组合成任务专属的图，依据环境证据验证结果，修订失败所牵涉的原语，并在验证通过后纳入新的或改进的原语。 我们用八类原语家族实例化HEELO，每类面向一种任务，并在二十多个基准上进行评估。 Dev-Primitives将Terminal-Bench 4.0在同一骨干上的解决率从Codex的37.3%提升到55.5%，按任务组合的Harness Primitives将Terminal-Bench 2.0的Pass@1从种子工具框架的60.0%提升到72.2%，Tool Primitives将ToolBench通过率从55.8%提升到75.1%，Navigation Primitives将GAIA-Text-103准确率从45.6%提升到58.3%。 在我们heeLO.dev平台的46个真实世界任务上，Claude Opus 5.5搭配Claude Code与GPT-6.1 Sol搭配Codex各自独立完成9个，而通过我们的MCP服务器接入HEELO后分别完成39个和35个，且每个完成任务的时间分别减少1.9倍和2.3倍，成本降低1.55倍。
